interpretation: Endpoint-specific validation status. Combining scores is a decision layer and does not establish a validated therapeutic outcome model.

endpoints.name: presentation
endpoints.validation_scope: grouped internal test; Zenodo record-level transfer; Nature direct failure
endpoints.evidence_boundary: does not prove tumour presentation or immunogenicity

endpoints.name: immunogenicity
endpoints.validation_scope: Ott/Zaghla descriptive endpoint audits; weak cross-study LOSO
endpoints.evidence_boundary: does not prove patient-specific T-cell activation or tumour killing

endpoints.name: rna_context
endpoints.evidence_boundary: does not predict custom circRNA half-life

endpoints.name: circRNA_translation
endpoints.target: circRNA translation evidence or measured yield
endpoints.validation_scope: sequence proxies and benchmark runner only
endpoints.evidence_boundary: requires construct-level assays and permitted labeled data

endpoints.name: lnp_delivery
endpoints.validation_scope: interface contract only; no local compatible labeled table
endpoints.evidence_boundary: spleen delivery does not imply tumour-cell delivery

endpoints.name: tumour_killing
endpoints.evidence_boundary: requires matched HLA, effector, tumour, and assay context
